android.extraProguardRules:
# --- RYZR release-build keep rules -------------------------------------
# R8 is on (enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds). React Native, Expo modules,
# Reanimated, Worklets, SVG, Health Connect, Notifications and Updates all
# ship their own consumer rules, so they need nothing here. These are the
# dependencies that ship NONE, and that reach classes by reflection.

# Readable stack traces in Play Console after obfuscation.
-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable,*Annotation*,Signature,InnerClasses,EnclosingMethod
-renamesourcefileattribute SourceFile

# JNI entry points: the native name must survive minification.
-keepclasseswithmembernames class * { native <methods>; }

# RevenueCat — purchase/entitlement models are deserialized reflectively.
-keep class com.revenuecat.purchases.** { *; }

# Facebook SDK — the RN bridge plus the SDK it calls into.
-keep class com.facebook.reactnative.androidsdk.** { *; }
-keep class com.facebook.** { *; }
-dontwarn com.facebook.**

# VisionCamera + its frame-processor plugins (loaded by name at runtime).
-keep class com.mrousavy.camera.** { *; }

# react-native-fast-tflite JNI bindings.
-keep class com.tflite.** { *; }

# expo-speech-recognition: native module, no consumer rules of its own.
-keep class expo.modules.speechrecognition.** { *; }

# LiteRT GPU delegate. react-native-fast-tflite pulls in
# com.google.ai.edge.litert:litert-gpu, whose GpuDelegate constructor
# references GpuDelegateFactory$Options from the litert-gpu-api artifact,
# which that dependency does not bring along. We never ask for the GPU
# delegate — tflitePose.ts calls loadTensorflowModel(asset) with no delegate
# argument, so MoveNet runs on CPU — and R8 shrinks the unreachable delegate
# away. Without this, R8 aborts on the dangling reference.
-dontwarn org.tensorflow.lite.gpu.**
